description: Start, stop or status of a hidden client run by the hub (offline mode): joins server (default: the server_process one) or opens a singleplayer world; returns its instance. First start downloads ~150 MB.

mods.description: Absolute paths of extra mod jars.

server.description: host:port. Default: the server started by server_process.

world.description: Open a singleplayer world instead of joining a server.

create.description: Create the world (else an existing save opens).

replace.description: Delete an existing save of this name first.

name: client_process
